Non-watertight rifle scopes.title: TRUGLORifle Scope
Non-watertight rifle scopes.description: TRUGLO OMNIA ILLUMINATED ALL PURPOSE TACTICAL RETICLE RIFLESCOPE: Created with modern sporting rifles in mind, OMNIA precision rifle scopes are designed with features and performance tailored to the modern rifleman and are available in various versions. This scope includes a detachable Quick-Zoom Lever for rapid transitions between magnification levels. Inside the OMNIA scope is the TRUGLO All-Purpose Tactical Reticle. The illuminated, glass-etched A.P.T.R. combines several targeting methods. A large 12-MOA illuminated "peep ring" is designed for quick sight alignment on near targets. Centered within the peep ring are illuminated crosshairs optimized for a 50/200 yard zero. The top of the crosshair provides a point-of-aim at 100 yards with the remaining subtensions calibrated for 300, 400, 500, and 600-yard bullet drop compensation. MAIN FEATURES: - Multi-coated lens for enhanced clarity and contrast; - 30mm tube for increased turret adjustment range and increased brightness; - Locking target turrets prevent accidental adjustment; - 1/2-MOA target turrets and intuitive reticle for simplified adjustments, tracking, and holdover; - Included one-piece mount for ideal mounting position on modern sporting rifles; - Illuminated All Purpose Tactical Reticle (A.P.T.R.); - Nitrogen gas-filled, fog-proof; - Illuminated glass-etched reticle; - Included flip-up lens caps; - Water and shock-resistant.
